scenes.title: A Nutty Morning
scenes.body: In a sunny forest, a little squirrel hopped through the grass, looking for tasty nuts. It found a big oak tree full of acorns and filled its tiny paws. The squirrel was so happy and proud of its treasure.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: A Sad Little Bird
scenes.body: The squirrel saw a little bluebird sitting on a mossy log, looking hungry and sad. The squirrel smiled and waddled over, offering the bird a delicious acorn. The bird's eyes lit up with surprise and joy.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: A Picnic Together
scenes.body: They shared all the nuts and had a happy picnic on the log. The bird sang a sweet thank-you song, and the squirrel danced along. From that day on, they always shared with each other, making the forest a kinder place.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about kindness.
